title: LAST DAYS OF 23 💖- Birthday Prep | Glazer + Glossy Launch | Beauty Maintenance vlog
description:
Damn! Where’s all the time going?
We literally did 23 in Japan like yesterday!
The clock really never stops ticking…

The last few days of 23 were a mix of everything, the highs, the lows, the excitement, the feeling of being overwhelmed but grateful at the same time, I’m so proud of me! This year was such a girl boss year and I stayed in charge, of everything.

I’m grateful to God, to my family & friends, to my shine babes and to you - Dianasty (our crew name haha). Thank you for making this year so much fun! I literally dedicated a portion of my life to you as I’ve stayed consistent on this platform, don’t ever think for a day that I do not love or value you because I DO ♥️

Alright, by the time you’re seeing this I’m already a 24 year old woman, wish me a happy birthday, like, comment, share and subscribe to my channel anddd
Shop my new Glazer & Glossy collection at www.theshinecartel.com 💖.

Alright! See you!
I’m off to have the best 24K Gold birthday ever ⭐️
Xoxo Diana
